title: The Phillips Collection

services.name: All Exhibitions
services.desc: In keeping with its long-standing commitment to championing the work of living artists in the Washington, DC, area, The Phillips Collection is proud to present a major exhibition showcasing 48 artists based in the greater DC region. The result of an open call that drew 1,500 applications, the exhibition brings together an intergenerational group of artists who are grappling with the complexities of the contemporary world, while celebrating the beauty, resilience, and determination that inspires their ongoing creative practice. services.name: Audio Tour
services.desc: Engage, explore, and connect with artworks on educator-guided or self-guided tours. We understand that plans can change and we want to accommodate your group’s needs as best as we can. However, in order to ensure that our resources are used efficiently and that as many groups as possible can enjoy our tours, please note our cancellation policy: If you have any questions, please contact tours@phillipscollection.org. We value your support and look forward to welcoming you for a tour! services.name: Lesson Plans
services.desc: Use the filters to find a lesson plan to implement in your classroom. These lessons may expand on existing curricular units or spark ideas for new units. The lessons focus on works of art at The Phillips Collection or on view in a special exhibition and utilize the Phillips’s Prism.K12 arts integration strategies. Each lesson includes a range of discussion topics, artmaking activities, guiding questions, writing prompts, strategies for looking at art, contextual information, and more.
